---
title: "How-To Guides"
description: "Start from a goal — model across scales, build a connectome, fit to data — and follow a recipe."
sidebar: howto
page-layout: full
---

Start from what you want to do. Each guide takes one goal and walks it end to
end. For the concepts behind a component see [Usage](../Usage/index.qmd); for how
TVBO lines up with a tool you already know see
[Interoperability](../Interoperability/index.qmd).

```{=html}
<style>
.howto-filters {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.howto-filters button {
  padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem;
  border: 1px solid #aaa;
  border-radius: 2rem;
  background: #f8f8f8;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}
.howto-filters button.active,
.howto-filters button:hover {
  background: #1a1a2e;
  color: #fff;
  border-color: #1a1a2e;
}
.howto-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
}
.howto-card {
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #fff;
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.howto-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); }
.howto-card a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
.howto-card .card-visual {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.howto-card .card-img-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  color: #fff;
}
.howto-card .card-body { padding: 0.8rem 1rem; flex: 1; }
.howto-card .card-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }
.howto-card .card-desc { font-size: 0.82rem; color: #555; line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
.howto-card .card-where { font-size: 0.72rem; color: #888; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
.howto-card .card-cats { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem; }
.howto-card .cat-tag {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: #eef0f8;
  color: #444;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.howto-card.hidden { display: none; }
</style>

<div class="howto-filters" id="howto-filters">
  <button class="active" data-cat="all">All</button>
</div>

<div class="howto-grid" id="howto-gallery"></div>

<script>
const PAGES = [
  { title: "Model Across Scales",
    href: "MultiScaleModelling.html",
    slug: "MultiScaleModelling",
    desc: "Couple a whole-brain mean-field network with a spiking, reservoir, or biophysical patch.",
    where: "How-To",
    cats: ["simulate","networks","multi-scale"] },
  { title: "Build a Connectome from Tractography",
    href: "BuildConnectomeFromTractography.html",
    slug: "BuildConnectomeFromTractography",
    desc: "Turn a tractogram and a parcellation atlas into a schema-compliant structural network.",
    where: "How-To",
    cats: ["networks","data"] },
  { title: "Fit a Model to Data",
    href: "../Interoperability/tvboptim/RWW_tvboptim.html",
    slug: "ModelFitting",
    desc: "Tune a mean-field model so its functional connectivity matches empirical BOLD.",
    where: "tvboptim backend",
    cats: ["fit","analysis"] },
  { title: "Infer Parameters (Bayesian)",
    href: "../Interoperability/tvboptim/Bayesian_tvboptim.html",
    slug: "Bayesian",
    desc: "Estimate posteriors over model parameters with MCMC.",
    where: "tvboptim backend",
    cats: ["fit","inference"] },
  { title: "Tune E/I Balance",
    href: "../Interoperability/tvboptim/EI_Tuning_tvboptim.html",
    slug: "Algorithms",
    desc: "Drive each region to a target firing rate by tuning excitation/inhibition.",
    where: "tvboptim backend",
    cats: ["fit","tuning"] },
  { title: "Explore a Parameter Space",
    href: "../Usage/ParameterExploration.html",
    slug: "ParameterExploration",
    desc: "Run systematic sweeps and grid searches across model parameters.",
    where: "Usage",
    cats: ["analysis","sweeps"] },
  { title: "Analyze Stability & Bifurcations",
    href: "../Usage/BifurcationAnalysis.html",
    slug: "BifurcationAnalysis",
    desc: "Find fixed points, assess stability, and trace bifurcation diagrams.",
    where: "Usage",
    cats: ["analysis","stability"] },
  { title: "Reproduce a Published Study",
    href: "../Replication/index.html",
    slug: "SimulationExperiments",
    desc: "Turn a paper into one declarative, fully computed replication study.",
    where: "Replication",
    cats: ["reproduce","fit"] },
];

// Enrich with icon/gradient from the shared global registry.
PAGES.forEach(p => {
  const info = (window.TVBO_ICONS && TVBO_ICONS[p.slug]) || {};
  p.icon = info.icon || "fa-solid fa-file";
  p.gradient = info.gradient || "linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)";
});

// Filter buttons from the union of categories.
const allCats = [...new Set(PAGES.flatMap(p => p.cats))].sort();
const filterBar = document.getElementById('howto-filters');
filterBar.querySelector('[data-cat="all"]').addEventListener('click', () => setFilter('all'));
allCats.forEach(cat => {
  const btn = document.createElement('button');
  btn.textContent = cat;
  btn.dataset.cat = cat;
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => setFilter(cat));
  filterBar.appendChild(btn);
});

// Build cards.
const gallery = document.getElementById('howto-gallery');
PAGES.forEach(p => {
  const card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'howto-card';
  card.dataset.cats = JSON.stringify(p.cats);

  const imgWrap = document.createElement('a');
  imgWrap.href = p.href;
  const visual = document.createElement('div');
  visual.className = 'card-visual';
  const ph = document.createElement('div');
  ph.className = 'card-img-placeholder';
  ph.style.background = p.gradient;
  ph.innerHTML = `<i class="${p.icon}" aria-hidden="true"></i>`;
  visual.appendChild(ph);
  imgWrap.appendChild(visual);
  card.appendChild(imgWrap);

  const body = document.createElement('div');
  body.className = 'card-body';
  const title = document.createElement('a');
  title.href = p.href;
  title.innerHTML = `<div class="card-title">${p.title}</div>`;
  body.appendChild(title);
  const desc = document.createElement('div');
  desc.className = 'card-desc';
  desc.textContent = p.desc;
  body.appendChild(desc);
  const where = document.createElement('div');
  where.className = 'card-where';
  where.textContent = p.where;
  body.appendChild(where);
  const cats = document.createElement('div');
  cats.className = 'card-cats';
  p.cats.forEach(c => {
    const tag = document.createElement('span');
    tag.className = 'cat-tag';
    tag.textContent = c;
    tag.addEventListener('click', () => setFilter(c));
    cats.appendChild(tag);
  });
  body.appendChild(cats);
  card.appendChild(body);
  gallery.appendChild(card);
});

let activeFilter = 'all';
function setFilter(cat) {
  activeFilter = cat;
  document.querySelectorAll('.howto-filters button').forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.cat === cat);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.howto-card').forEach(card => {
    const cardCats = JSON.parse(card.dataset.cats);
    card.classList.toggle('hidden', cat !== 'all' && !cardCats.includes(cat));
  });
}
</script>
```
